name: Australian Centre for the Moving Image

facts.claim: ACMI is Australia's national museum of screen culture, at Federation Square opposite Flinders Street Station
Its ongoing Story of the Moving Image exhibition on film, TV, videogames and digital culture is free
Temporary exhibitions and cinema screenings are ticketed separately

name: Arts Centre Melbourne

facts.claim: Performing arts precinct on St Kilda Road with theatres, Hamer Hall and the landmark spire
Designed by Roy Grounds; the gallery opened 1968 and the theatres and concert hall followed
Guided tours are listed as not currently available; a Collection Store tour is about $43 adult

name: St Patrick's Cathedral

facts.claim: Gothic Revival cathedral designed by William Wardell, built 1858 to 1939 in bluestone
Seat of the Catholic Archbishop of Melbourne, consecrated 1897, on Gisborne Street in East Melbourne

name: Fitzroy Gardens

facts.claim: Heritage-listed gardens set aside as a reserve in 1848 in East Melbourne, about 26 hectares
Lawns and paths lined with mature elm trees in Victorian-era design
Contains the Conservatory, Cooks' Cottage and a visitor centre

name: Cooks' Cottage

facts.claim: Cottage built in 1755 in Yorkshire by the parents of Captain James Cook
Moved to Melbourne in 1934 by Sir Russell Grimwade and rebuilt in Fitzroy Gardens
Surrounded by an English cottage garden; tickets sold at the Fitzroy Gardens Visitor Centre
